openObservations.observation: The published screenshot evidence/real-backend-40068292422/patched-authenticated-patched.png reproduces the user's exact UI ('Live' badge, 'Launch unavailable', 'No Web Desktop URL', 'No runner host published yet'). The F201-fixed auto-login note correctly reads 'Waiting for the first status answer; nothing has been measured yet', but the separate Troubleshooting issue card still renders 'CONFIRMED ... launch gates are failing - source: auto-login gate (credentials / runner DNS / RDP listener)'. That card is fed by src/lib/overview/readiness.ts blockers from the trusted 200 /api/native-status body (the synthetic lab config genuinely has no valid FQDN/creds/listener), so it may be legitimate here; it is NOT asserted as a defect. A future session should confirm the issue-classification 'confirmed' wording obeys the same probe-trust rule as F201 on a LIVE run and on a genuinely missing-probe state.

blockingPrerequisitesForFullAcceptance: The pinned origin ended at staging with no live signal; a FRESH main.yml mode=rdp run URL is needed to verify the LIVE origin end-to-end (operator action requested once).

R2 (inline /ws accept-loop block) is CONFIRMED but UNFIXED — the correct runspace-pool dispatch is a large PS 5.1 change that needs a dedicated Windows-verification session. Until R2 is fixed, the live dashboard will keep freezing after the WebSocket opens.
Native RDP and Web Desktop need a real signed launcher, a real captured session and a real credential chain; the lab candidate is loopback with synthetic identity and these are honestly BLOCKED.

The lab-stub candidate sweep (run 40068292398) and standalone capability TLS gate (run 40068292407) remain honestly non-green at the definitive head; their BLOCKED/NOT_RUN criteria are not collapsed into acceptance.
